queries:
SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT city_id) FROM address) AS ratio_to_avg, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS share
FROM address
GROUP BY city_id
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT rating,
       COUNT(*) AS film_count,
       COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM film GROUP BY rating)) AS pct_of_average,
       COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film) AS pct_share
FROM film
GROUP BY rating
SELECT rating,
       COUNT(*) AS film_count,
       COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT rating) FROM film) AS diff_from_average,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film) AS share
FROM film
GROUP BY rating;
SELECT c.city, COUNT(a.address_id) AS address_count, COUNT(a.address_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS share
FROM city c
JOIN address a ON a.city_id = c.city_id
GROUP BY c.city_id, c.city
HAVING COUNT(a.address_id) > (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 FROM address) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM city);
SELECT c.city, COUNT(a.address_id) AS address_count
FROM city c
LEFT JOIN address a ON a.city_id = c.city_id
GROUP BY c.city_id, c.city
ORDER BY address_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
